source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 3 (ISL A3) · lesson 18. Rewritten for children from Dr. Hassan's lesson; facts and references kept.

learn.en: Khadījah bint Khuwaylid was a wise, respected businesswoman in Makkah, known for her noble character.
learn.title: Who was she?

learn.en: She hired Muhammad ﷺ to trade for her and saw how honest he was. She asked to marry him. Theirs was a marriage of love and loyalty.
learn.title: An honest man

learn.en: Their children: al-Qāsim and ʿAbdullāh, who died young, and four daughters — Zaynab, Ruqayyah, Umm Kulthūm and Fāṭimah.
learn.title: Their children

learn.en: Khadījah was the first person to believe in the Prophet ﷺ, and the first Mother of the Believers.
learn.title: The first believer

learn.en: Jibrīl told the Prophet ﷺ to give Khadījah greetings of peace from her Lord and from him, and good news of a house in Paradise. (Bukhari 3820)
learn.title: Salām from Allah

quiz.en: Who was the first person to believe in the Prophet ﷺ?
How did Khadījah learn about the Prophet's character?
True or false? The Prophet ﷺ had four daughters with Khadījah.
True or false? Jibrīl brought Khadījah greetings from her Lord.

think.q: Can you name the Prophet's four daughters?
think.a: Zaynab, Ruqayyah, Umm Kulthūm and Fāṭimah — raḍiya llāhu ʿanhunn.

parents.summary: Khadījah was wise, generous and loyal — the first to believe and the first Mother of the Believers. Allah sent her salām and a house in Paradise.
parents.tip: Ask your child to name one quality of Khadījah they want to copy.
